headline: ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI
summary: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached FBI systems using an Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day, stealing data on employees and job applicants, which TechCrunch warns could be used to extort agents.

claims.statement: ShinyHunters claims it breached FBI systems and stole data on employees and job applicants.

sources.quote: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents’ and applicants’ data
stealing sensitive data on employees and job applicants

claims.statement: The breach reportedly used a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability.

sources.quote: using a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability

claims.statement: TechCrunch warns the stolen data could be used to extort agents and their families into cooperating with a foreign government.
